caption_en: Heading errors with OiSAM reinitialized at recorded IMU gaps. Left panels show all matched dynamic-output epochs throughout the three trials. Right panels enlarge a fixed central interval for nominal walking and the first restart inside the other two evaluation windows. Light shading in the left panels identifies the enlarged interval; darker shading in the right panels marks the recorded IMU gap. Initialization-only states are excluded, and curves break across unavailable dynamic outputs. Both methods use the same nominal evaluation seconds and the same heading convention. These heading comparisons do not mix the different position reference points used in the archived evaluations.
